message.content:
The title of “best player” in soccer is highly subjective and often depends on the criteria you value most—technical skill, consistency, impact in big games, or overall influence on the sport. As of 2026, many pundits and fans still consider **Lionel Messi** and **Kylian Mbappé** to be the top contenders:

| Player | Current Club | Key Strengths | Recent Highlights |
|--------|--------------|---------------|-------------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Inter Miami (MLS) | Vision, dribbling, play‑making, goal‑scoring | Won the MLS Cup in 2023, continued to break records in the Copa América 2024 |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | Paris Saint‑Germain (PSG) | Speed, finishing, versatility | Scored 30+ league goals in 2025, helped PSG win the UEFA Champions League 2025 |

Other players frequently mentioned include **Erling Haaland** (Manchester City), **Kevin De Bruyne** (Manchester City), and **Neymar Jr.** (Al‑Hilal). Ultimately, the “best” player can vary depending on whether you prioritize club success, international achievements, or individual flair.
